b'# tinydl

A small command line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the result to a file or to stdout, retrying a few times on network errors.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [-o OUTPUT] [-q]
```

## Command line options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.tar.gz
tinydl https://example.com/file.tar.gz -o file.tar.gz
tinydl https://example.com/file.tar.gz --output file.tar.gz --quiet
```
'
